state.paragraph: On July 3, 2013, Mr. Rothenberg called a representative of Goodwin Procter to indicate that he had spoken with representatives of Pamplona about Moab's desire to maintain the flexibility to consider a possible equity rollover if Pamplona were to participate in a business combination with Mac-Gray. Mr. Rothenberg also informed Goodwin Procter that Pamplona would be requesting that any confidentiality agreement CSC/Pamplona execute with Mac-Gray permit CSC and Pamplona to discuss their bid and evaluation material with Moab, with Moab agreeing to exclusively engage with CSC/Pamplona.

contact.instructions: `paragraph` reports that the target or its banker contacts potential buyers, or a potential buyer approaches the target, including counts of parties contacted. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
